selection_feedback_channels.retention: last 12 ledger JSON rows injected verbatim into state.md
selection_feedback_channels.adaptive_effect: direct semantic feedback to later proposal generation

selection_feedback_channels.retention: not bounded to 12 ledger rows; accumulated lesson text is re-injected across rounds
selection_feedback_channels.source: LLM distillation receives gate=led_verdict plus train/repair evidence and round review
selection_feedback_channels.adaptive_effect: compresses hidden-dev-derived aggregate gate evidence into longer-lived semantic memory

selection_feedback_channels.source: progressive mode may use a strict-REJECT candidate as next working base when dev or repair net is positive and no significant harm is found
selection_feedback_channels.adaptive_effect: hidden-dev-derived selection changes the parent from which future proposals are generated

identity_leak_hypothesis.observation: Current driver constructs perfect-stratum damage from dev matrices and retains held_out_damage in led_verdict while only raw matrices/fingerprints are removed; therefore dev task identifiers can be released when damage is nonempty.
identity_leak_hypothesis.status: code-path observation on current main; exact paper-run source revision not independently inspectable because champions.lock settled_software SHA is not publicly resolvable
identity_leak_hypothesis.do_not_overgeneralize: This does not establish that semantic task text, raw dev outputs, or all hidden task identities were exposed in the published campaign.

retention_conclusion: The effective adaptive selection-feedback channel is wider and longer-lived than a 12-row ledger tail because gate-derived information can persist through distilled lessons, latest round review, and parent-state transitions.

preregistered_bandwidth_ablation.status: preregistered; not executed because a fixed public paper-run proposal chronology is unavailable
preregistered_bandwidth_ablation.goal: Measure adaptive selection overfit caused by release bandwidth while holding proposal opportunity and outer evaluation fixed.
